description: Jacob's Ladder of Assets: a total, ordered asset-class ontology grounding the estate omnirisk `asset_class` axis in the real economy, from tangible extraction (0) to pure digital services (8). Replaces the thin {credit,equity,market,crypto} enum and supplies EP's value-genesis (extraction + labor-mixing are where Revenue originates before it is a financial claim). Each rung binds a valuation_model and an RM-1 risk_F_family.

rungs.label: Natural capital (land / deposits / ecosystems / biological stock)
rungs.risk_F_note: coherent tail (ES) over the joint reserve x commodity-price distribution of the in-situ stock
rungs.genesis_note: Value = scarcity x location x option-to-extract (a real option on the underlying reserve). The base of the ladder: nature before any labor is mixed in.

rungs.label: Extractive non-renewable (mining / drilling)
rungs.risk_F_note: commodity-price tail plus a monotone depletion path toward the absorbing barrier at zero reserves
rungs.genesis_note: Hotelling rule: in-situ price (scarcity rent) grows at the interest rate r; the optimal-depletion program empties a DEPLETING stock. Extraction is a first site of Revenue genesis.

rungs.label: Renewable harvest (farming / forestry / fishing / animal husbandry)
rungs.risk_F_note: downside deviation of realized yield below the maximum-sustainable-yield target under weather / biological shocks
rungs.genesis_note: Sustainable-yield: value from a REGENERATING flow harvested at or below its renewal rate. Mean-reverting (OU-like) stock dynamics; weather / biological risk. Overharvesting collapses the flow.

rungs.label: Processed goods (refining / manufacturing / craft)
rungs.risk_F_note: coherent tail over the processing-margin distribution (input cost, throughput, spoilage)
rungs.genesis_note: Lockean value-add = labor + capital + know-how mixed into extracted / harvested inputs. A reproducible flow whose price mean-reverts toward marginal cost. The peak of physical value-genesis.

rungs.label: Commodity market (grains / metals / energy)
rungs.risk_F_note: spectral (coherent) risk over the loss distribution implied by the vol surface; consumes the FTP/market vol-surface engine (#44)
rungs.genesis_note: Spot + futures + vol surface: the claim layer over physical commodities. References the merged economic-prophet market/vol-surface work (#44).

rungs.label: Labor market (human capital / wages)
rungs.risk_F_note: downside deviation of realized wage / human-capital return below its productivity anchor
rungs.genesis_note: Human capital priced as a wage / productivity claim. References the Labor Network Charter (prophet-workspace #109). A person's labor-hours are RIVAL.

rungs.label: Mercantile trade (merchants / logistics / arbitrage)
rungs.risk_F_note: coherent tail over inventory / transit / basis risk while goods are in motion
rungs.genesis_note: Value from moving goods across space and time (arbitrage of price differences). No transformation of the good itself -- only of its position.

rungs.label: Pure service (contract cash-flow)
rungs.risk_F_note: coherent tail over the contracted cash-flow / credit-loss distribution
rungs.genesis_note: Contract / cash-flow DCF -- the traditional EP object. A rival service (delivered capacity is consumed) valued by discounting its cash flows.

rungs.label: Digital asset (tokens / data / software / IP)
rungs.risk_F_note: coherent tail (ES) over a REFLEXIVE, fat-tailed return distribution F; consumes the crypto asset-class contract in flight (CAV-1)
rungs.genesis_note: NON-RIVAL. Value is network / memetic (Metcalfe, NVT), not scarcity: copying is free, so a scarcity/DCF price is the WRONG model. References the crypto asset-class contract in flight.

rungs.label: Digital service (SaaS / agentic / information)
rungs.risk_F_note: spectral (coherent) risk over the epistemic-delta distribution of the information service
rungs.genesis_note: Economia Mentium: value = epistemic delta (knowledge added), liquidity = attention. NON-RIVAL and unbounded by physical stock. The top of the ladder.
